mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 讲碳排放、智能电网与粮食安全。仿写训练精选课文金句，并收录课堂‘as...so do... 倒装、which 非限定从句、动词生动化’的同学优秀仿写。

items.focusType: which 非限制性定语从句(指代整句)
items.focus: 用 ‘which in turn...’ 让 which 指代前面整件事，表达‘而这又反过来……’，串起因果链。
items.original: They produce a large quantity of carbon dioxide, which in turn traps heat and causes global warming.
items.cn: 它们排放大量二氧化碳，而这些二氧化碳又困住热量、造成全球变暖。

models.en: He kept putting off the work, which in turn piled up the pressure and stole his sleep.
The village planted thousands of trees, which in turn cooled the air and brought the birds back.

items.tip: which 指代前面整个分句时，前面必须有逗号(非限制性)；in turn 强调‘反过来/继而’。

items.focusType: As + 从句, so do + 主语 (倒装)
items.focus: 用 ‘As A increases, so does B’ 表达‘随着 A……，B 也随之……’，so 后用倒装，气势工整。
items.original: As global temperatures increase, so do sea levels.
items.cn: 随着全球气温上升，海平面也随之上升。

models.en: As the first ray of dawn breaks through the darkness, so do faith and hope begin to chase away fear and despair in our hearts.
As our knowledge grows, so does our sense of how much remains unknown.

items.tip: so 后接助动词(do/does/did) + 主语，构成部分倒装；千万别写成 so sea levels do。

items.focus: 把普通动词换成 generate(催生)、inject(注入活力)等，让句子更有张力，是升格的关键。
items.original: Extreme temperatures generate extreme rainfall patterns.
items.cn: 极端气温催生出极端的降雨模式。

models.en: You can integrate group discussion into teaching, as the exchange of ideas generates innovative points of view, injecting vitality into your class.
A single act of kindness can generate a chain of warmth, injecting hope into a whole community.

items.tip: generate/spark/breed 都能替换 cause/produce；injecting... 用现在分词作结果状语收尾很漂亮。
